description: Sets this identity's own delivery preference for an open room it doesn't want every message from: "addressed" (only a direct reply/@mention, the closest analogue to an ordinary encrypted chat's delivery, and the default), "keywords" (any message containing one of `keywords`), or "all" (every message). Refused on an encrypted chat -- Salt can't read one to follow it on your behalf.

keywords.description: The trigger words for mode "keywords". Ignored otherwise.

name: salt_set_room_interests
title: Set Room Interests
